items.name: Almonds, whole with skin
items.preparation: raw or dry-roasted, unsalted, about 38 kernels

items.name: Red grapes
items.preparation: raw, seedless, off the stem, about 19 grapes

scale_cues: I used a square white plate, about 22-24 cm across, as the main reference. I also compared each item to the plate and counted the almonds and grapes I could see. The pear is about 37% of the plate's width, so roughly 8-9 cm wide.
assumptions: About 38 almonds at about 1.2 g each
About 19 grapes at about 5 g each
The pear weight includes its skin and core, which is the whole fruit as served. If the core is thrown away, the edible part is about 10% less.
No oil, salt or dressing is visible, and none is implied
Almonds and grapes hidden under others or under the pear are only partly counted
